name: motif_proposals
description:
Show a Proposal. Reads one saved Proposal or Draft by id, with its status, label, Rationale, Comments and operations; --current adds the value each change's field holds now, and an Applied Proposal carries its appliedRecord: the effects and evidence counts Apply saved. In JSON Comments, missing findings means unchecked, [] means checked and clean, and a non-empty array lists findings. It returns the first 10 operations and names the next offset; --limit, --offset, --page and --all read the rest. It does not change the FieldWorks project.
Command: show. Agent class: Read.
ProposalId: A Draft name or the exact canonical identity of a Draft or finalized Proposal.
WithCurrent: Also reads, from the saved project, the value each change's field holds now, with no Trial.
Records: Lists a record import's files, one row each, instead of its operations.
List Proposals. Lists every Proposal with what it changes and the numbers its latest Trial measured beside today's. Proposals are grouped by what to do next; applied and set-aside ones are counted unless asked for. Add --include-set-aside to list closed ones too, or --status to list one status.
Command: proposals. Agent class: Read.
IncludeSetAside: Whether closed (applied, rejected, superseded, withdrawn) Proposals are listed too.
Status: Lists only Proposals in this stored status (draft, proposed, deferred, applied, rejected, superseded or withdrawn), open or closed.

proposal.description: A Draft name or Proposal id to show in full. Omit to list.

include_set_aside.description: Also list applied, rejected, superseded and deferred.

status.description: List only Proposals in this status, open or closed.

current.description: With proposal: also read the value each change's field holds in the saved project now, before any Trial.

records.description: With proposal: list a record import's files, one row each (path, record, kind, create or update, operations, batch edges), instead of its operations.

sort.description: With records: order the rows by path (the default), kind or batch-edges.

refused.description: With records: list only the files the import refused.

offset.description: How many rows to skip; a result that was cut names the offset of the next page as nextOffset.

all.description: Return every row instead of one page; the page size is limit, or the default, without it.

detail.description: 'concise' (default) drops empty fields and long lists; 'detailed' returns everything.

limit.description: Page size for paged reads (findings, operations: default 10; proposals list: default 25), and the most list items in concise mode elsewhere (default 25).

project.description: Known project name or recorded .fwdata path.
